chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'id narrated from some of his men, from Ali ibn Imara al-Kinani, who said: Muhammad ibn Sinan narrated from Abul Jarood, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

I said to him: 'Advise me.' He said: 'I advise you to fear Allah, to stay in your house and sit among the masses of these people. Beware of the Kharijites from us, for they are on nothing and lead to nothing. Know that the Umayyads have a dominion that people cannot restrain, and that the people of Truth will have a state; when it comes, Allah will entrust it to whomever He wishes from us, the Ahl al-Bayt. Whoever from you attains it will be with us in the highest peak (of Paradise), and if Allah takes him before that, He will choose for him what is best. Know that no group will rise to repel oppression or strengthen religion except that they are crushed by death and calamity, until a group rises who fought in Badr with the Messenger of Allah, whose dead are not buried, whose fallen are not lifted, and whose wounded are not cured.' I said: 'Who are they?' He said: 'The angels.'

key_terms.أَهْلَ الْبَيْت: The People of the House (Ahl al-Bayt)

ai.seo_question: What is the advice given by Imam al-Baqir regarding seclusion and the Kharijites, and who are the angels in the context of the final rising?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Nu'mani’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* encapsulates the core Shia doctrine of *al-intizar* (waiting for deliverance), balancing spiritual vigilance with political realism regarding the temporary dominance of the Umayyads. It introduces a unique eschatological nuance by identifying the angels themselves as the 'faction' that will ultimately establish justice after human trials, emphasizing divine agency in the final victory. The advice to remain in seclusion among the 'common people' (*dehma*) reflects the historical strategy of avoiding premature uprisings while maintaining communal presence.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (2) Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Sa’eed narrated from some of his companions from Ali bin Imara al-Kinani from Muhammad bin Sinan that Abul Jarood had said: I said to Abu Ja’far al-Baqir (as): Please, advise me!”

He said: “I advise you to fear Allah, to stay at home and to be away from these masses of people. Beware of the Kharijites because they are not on the straight path nor will they get to a pleasant end. Know that the Umayyads have a strong rule that people can not stand against. Know that the faithful people will have a state. If that happens, Allah will entrust one of us with it. If anyone of you lives until that time, he will be with us in the highest position (of Paradise) and if he dies before that, Allah will choose to him as He wills. Know that no group rising to resist oppression or to defend faith unless death is the end until a group, that has fought with the Prophet (S) in the battle of Badr and whose killed ones are not buried, whose felled ones are not lifted and whose wounded ones are not cured, rises.” I asked: “Who are they?” He said: “The angels.”
